decisions.reason: The naval vessel lighting system draws on the firm's specialized marine and defense competence, involves heavy certification and project investment, and has stayed listed in both years, so management will defend the commitment.

Promotion of the C80-P G2 dropped from a dedicated page in 2023 to a bare mention in 2024, but as a second-generation core interior luminaire it marks a product line the firm has invested in, and the softer visibility can be read as a normal post-launch phase.
The firm is publicly featuring the C94-P microprismatic pendant as a latest release in 2024, a fresh visible commitment that makes withdrawal within a year very unlikely.

The firm already pruned the HMI searchlight in its marine searchlight portfolio, which leaves this remaining searchlight as the carrier of that investment and marine positioning, so management will persist with it.
